# Original Candidate Description

This is the unmodified `student.agent.md` from the repository at the time of the optimization run.

**Known failure modes** (from engineer-prompt/review.md):
1. No explicit evidence reading order before drafting
2. "Smallest defensible revision" undefined
3. Loop-exit criterion underspecified
4. Reasoning format choice unconstrained
5. "Unclear revision target" has no concrete criterion
6. Validation step does not name `python -m pytest -q`
